messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a list of the long weekends (public holidays that fall on or adjacent to a weekend) in Canada for 2023. These dates are the ones most people will have off work, so they’re great for planning short trips.

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day |  |
| **January 2** | Monday | New Year’s Day (Observed) |  |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba) |  |
| **March 17** | Friday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) |  |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday |  |
| **March 21** | Tuesday | Easter Monday (Quebec, Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **April 7** | Monday | Victoria Day (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **June 19** | Monday | Victoria Day (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day |  |
| **July 2** | Sunday | Canada Day (Observed) |  |
| **July 3** | Monday | Canada Day (Observed) |  |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **November 10** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day |  |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) |  |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Create a data structure** – Store each holiday as an object with `date`, `day`, `holiday`, and `notes` fields.
2. **Filter by region** – If your users are in specific provinces, filter the list accordingly.
3. **Highlight long weekends** – Mark holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday (or are observed on a Monday or Sunday) as “long weekend” so users can see them at a glance.
4. **Calendar integration** – Use a calendar library (e.g., FullCalendar, React Big Calendar) to display these dates on a calendar view.
5. **Reminders** – Offer push notifications or email reminders a week before each long weekend.

Let me know if you’d like the data in JSON format or if you need help integrating it into a particular framework!
